study: Fresh paired opening-manifest and native baseline pilot on qualified held-out IWIBench tasks
selection: One official test row from each of the five families with fully deterministic qualified scoring. Select minimum sha256("iwi-matched-manifest-live-pilot-v1|"+id) in each family; order families by the same hash. No selection using editing outcomes.

budget.unit: conservative API cost upper bound; includes unknown requests at their full reservation

arms.paged: Harness with causal SAE policy and four writable names/shapes shown up front; all remaining names accessible by the standard paginated tool.
arms.eager: Identical harness, prompt policy, public task, feedback, numerical tools, run limits and access; all writable names/shapes shown up front.
arms.native: Official qualified native service with stock public opening and four tools. Same requested editor, reasoning, turn/output/dollar caps and deterministic qualified grader. Native tool budgets, feedback, task serialization and submission semantics retained.

primary: Paired total provider editor tokens (cached input + uncached input + output) for paged vs eager. Sum over all attempted episodes; record terminations, submissions, missing usages, open turn and first common-turn prefix. No hidden-score peeking or rerolls.
quality: Report per-task paired native reward, number of improved and previously-correct target answers preserved, control retention, and failures. One trajectory per arm per task. This sample has no prespecified quality equivalence margin and cannot certify equivalence.
auxiliary: Native is a bundled reference. Target forwards and tokens are separate from editor tokens. Report cached/uncached and cost upper bounds separately. Full 150-task static opening replay and same-family fixed-patch transfer are independent analyses.
